test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a code language,

 A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’

 A - B means ‘A is the father of B’

 A * B means ‘A is the brother of B’

 A div B means ‘A is the mother of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to E if ‘ P - T * C + D div E ’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 *
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Father
 Brother
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: ‘ P - T * C + D div E ’

It means: P is the Father of T, T is the Brother of C, C is the Sister of D, D is the Mother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a34e674b57a23a87c9f59d362ed62f790f61d6653b6c74e6c635270547b2db14.png] 

So, P is the **Mother’s father **of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
